# `summary-changed`

Summary changed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `docs` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `summary-changed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Docs (annotations only) ([RULES.md section 10](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A `summary` changed.

## Why this default

Documentation only.

## Example

From test case [`summary-changed`](../../test/cases/summary-changed/): An operation's summary changed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
      get:
        operationId: listPets
-       summary: List pets
+       summary: List all pets
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `summary-changed` · info · GET /pets

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  summary-changed: info
```
